invariants: book.isbn must be unique across all books
author.id must be unique across all authors
member.email must be unique across all members
loan.book_id must reference a valid book
loan.member_id must reference a valid member
loan.return_date must be null if status is 'active'
loan.return_date must be set if status is 'returned'
loan.due_date must be a valid date (not in the past) when created
loan.loan_date must be a valid date (not in the past) when created
member.membership_date must be a valid date (not in the past) when created
book.published_year must be a valid year (e.g., 1900–current year)
